research.summary: The New Relic PHP agent is an APM agent for PHP applications. The vendor publishes an EOL policy page with a table of release dates and end-of-support dates for each minor version, with day-precision dates. There is no API or structured EOL feed.
research.notes: The vendor EOL policy page publishes a table with day-precision Start date (GA) and End date (EOL) for each PHP agent minor version. The End date is the terminal support date — no separate eos or eossec dates are published. The Start date is the GA date. The page states 'Any versions not listed in the following table are no longer supported.' Day-precision ISO dates are used directly.
